# Zooka Business TallyGST Cloud - Enterprise Accounting, Invoicing & GST Compliance

> Zooka Business (zookabusiness.in) is a modern, multi-tenant cloud accounting, GST tax compliance, banking reconciliation, and enterprise financial management platform built specifically for Indian businesses, chartered accountants, and enterprises.

## Core Capabilities
- Multi-Tenant Workspace Architecture with complete data isolation and JWT-authenticated session security.
- Indian GST Compliance Engine: Automated calculations for CGST, SGST, IGST, UTGST across all 36 Indian states and union territories.
- E-Invoicing & E-Way Bill Readiness: Instant JSON generation compliant with GSTN standard schemas.
- Dual-Entry Ledger Accounting: Real-time Trial Balance, Profit & Loss Statements, Balance Sheets, and Cash Flow analytics.
- Automated Bank Reconciliation: Multi-bank statement imports, rule-based reconciliation, and automated discrepancy detection.
- 5-Tier Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Super Admin, Admin, Manager, Accountant, and Viewer with granular permissions.
- Live GST Quick Calculator Simulator: Real-time tax breakdown with reverse tax extraction.

## Geographical & Jurisdiction Coverage (GEO)
- Domain: https://zookabusiness.in
- Country: India (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2: IN)
- Currency: Indian Rupee (INR ₹)
- State Jurisdictions: All 36 State and Union Territory codes (Maharashtra 27, Delhi 07, Karnataka 29, Gujarat 24, Tamil Nadu 33, Uttar Pradesh 09, West Bengal 19, etc.)
- Tax Regimes: Regular GST, Composition Scheme, Special Economic Zone (SEZ), Export with/without IGST.
